description: Wifi-zoner is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Tomelilla kommun. Here you can see wifi zones in Tomelilla municipality. Coverage: Tomelilla kommun. The portal shows the English title as "Wi-Fi zones" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Tomelilla kommun. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
